claims.text: Reversal for Xa inhibitors: nonspecific prohemostatic agents (PCC);
claims.quote: reversal agents for DOACs include targeted antidotes (ie, idarucizumab for dabigatran; andexanet alfa for the factor Xa inhibitors), as well as nonspecific prohemostatic agents such as prothrombin complex concentrates

claims.text: andexanet alfa (Andexxa) ⍉manufactured or sold in the US after December 22, 2025.
claims.quote: Andexxa will no longer be manufactured for or sold in the U.S. by AstraZeneca after December 22, 2025.
claims.locator: Update on the Safety of Andexxa by AstraZeneca: FDA Safety Communication

claims.text: Azole antifungals and protease inhibitors raise oral Xa inhibitor levels; certain antiseizure drugs and RIF lower them.
claims.quote: azole antifungal therapy and protease inhibitors will increase oral factor Xa inhibitor levels, and certain antiseizure medications and rifampin will decrease oral factor Xa inhibitor levels
